title: Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan
text: Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan Plan IRP-2026-A · Classification: Restricted · Owner: CISO Purpose This plan describes how Northstar Holdings detects, contains, eradicates, and recovers from cybersecurity incidents. It is Restricted because it documents detection sources, escalation paths, and decision criteria. Distribution is limited to Security Operations, the CISO office, Compliance, and named executives. Do not forward this document. Severity model Incidents are graded P1 through P4.

title: Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan
text: his document. Severity model Incidents are graded P1 through P4. A P1 incident is an active compromise of production finance, identity, or customer systems, ransomware encryption, or confirmed exfiltration of Restricted data. P1 incidents require a 15-minute response from Security Operations and a 60-minute executive briefing. P2 incidents are confirmed intrusions with limited blast radius and require a 1-hour response. P3 incidents are suspicious activity needing investigation within 4 hours.

title: Information Security Policy
text: ISP-2026-01 · Information Security Policy Northstar Holdings — Internal Use Page 1 Information Security Policy Policy ID ISP-2026-01 · Effective 1 January 2026 · Classification: Confidential 1. Purpose and scope This policy establishes mandatory controls for protecting Northstar Holdings information assets, including customer records, financial data, source code, and audit workpapers. It applies to all employees, contractors, and vendors with network or document access.

title: Information Security Policy

Exceptions require written approval from the Chief Information Security Officer. 2. Password and authentication standard All interactive accounts must use a minimum password length of 14 characters, mixing upper and lower case letters, a numeral, and a symbol. Passwords must be rotated every 90 days and must not reuse any of the prior 12 passwords.

title: Information Security Policy
text: every 90 days and must not reuse any of the prior 12 passwords. Shared service accounts are prohibited except where a vaulted credential is approved by Security Engineering. Multi-factor authentication is required for privileged access, remote VPN, and any system that stores Confidential or Restricted data. Passwords must never be stored in plain text, tickets, or chat messages. 3. Data classification Information is labeled Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted.

Restricted information includes incident response runbooks, encryption keys, and unpublished vulnerability findings.

text: ISP-2026-01 · Information Security Policy Northstar Holdings — Internal Use Page 2 4. Access control Access follows least privilege and role-based permissions. New access requests are ticketed, approved by the data owner, and provisioned within two business days. Access reviews occur quarterly for Confidential systems and monthly for Restricted systems. Terminated workforce members must have all access revoked within four hours of HR notification.

Mandate Internal Audit provides independent assurance to the Audit and Risk Committee that governance, risk management, and control processes are effective. The Chief Audit Executive is Priya Raman.
